title: Zypper requires --non-interactive for automated scripts
description: Zypper prompts interactively on conflicts or license agreements by default.
do_not_do: Do not execute bare zypper in scripts.

title: Btrfs Snapper automatic snapshots can consume storage
description: Automated pre/post snapshots on zypper transactions can exhaust free blocks on /.
recommendation: Inspect snapshots with sudo snapper list and prune with snapper cleanup number.
do_not_do: Do not delete snapshot subvolumes manually without using snapper.

title: Zypper restricts repository vendor change by default
description: Packages will not automatically upgrade to versions from different repository vendors.
recommendation: Supply --allow-vendor-change when intentionally upgrading from external repos (e.g. Packman).
do_not_do: Do not assume packages automatically switch repository sources.
